data_assets.public_description: Closed-endpoint Chain A C-alpha coordinate derivative.
Open-endpoint Chain A C-alpha coordinate derivative.
Original frozen official RCSB PDB record for the G10V non-reference static sample.
G10V Chain A C-alpha coordinate derivative for one reference-relative static comparison.

research_question: Given open and closed ADK structural anchors and one supplied non-reference static structure, what reference-relative conformational coverage can be described, and which dynamical, population, kinetic, energetic, or mechanistic interpretations remain unsupported?

permitted_facts: The source uses PDB 1AKE as a closed adenylate-kinase endpoint and PDB 4AKE as an open endpoint.
The described endpoint preparation removes solvent and heteroatoms and does not perform structural refinement before comparison.
The source is context for static structural anchors; it does not supply an independently deposited ADK trajectory or population estimate.
source_materials.source_locator: Raghuram, DynaMune preprint 2026, DOI 10.21203/rs.3.rs-8999467/v1; local text derivative Section 3.1 lines 397-710.

permitted_facts: The admitted non-reference input is the static E. coli adenylate-kinase G10V PDB structure 1E4V.
The frozen derivative retains Chain A C-alpha coordinates in residue order 1-214.
This static mutant structure is a non-reference sample for a descriptive geometric comparison only; it is not a trajectory, ensemble, wild-type equivalence result, or dynamical state assignment.
source_materials.source_locator: RCSB PDB entry 1E4V, https://www.rcsb.org/structure/1E4V; official archive data usage policy https://www.rcsb.org/pages/usage-policy.

permitted_facts: All three frozen Chain A coordinate arrays have declared residue-order coverage 1-214.
The two endpoint arrays are references; 1E4V G10V is the only non-reference sample in this development packet.
A rigidly aligned RMSD can describe whole-chain reference-relative proximity but cannot establish a transition path, population, kinetic process, free energy, mechanism, or portability.
